round6_research.bug_semantics: CWE-78 OS command injection (already complete in semantics field).
evidence: GitHub advisory GHSA-64vr-4gr2-m642 / CVE-2026-30635 (published 2026-05-11): command injection in automagik-genie 2.5.27 MCP server via view_task (view) in readTranscriptFromCommit in dist/mcp/server.js when reading from an external FORGE_BASE_URL; CWE-78, CVSS 8.1.

Vulnerable sink present at v2.5.27 (9811c738054d817ce39ea05f05e28ae9312819f4): src/mcp/server.ts lines 163-183 define readTranscriptFromCommit with execSync(`git --git-dir="${gitDir}" log -1 --format="%B" ${commitSha}`); commitSha interpolated outside double quotes.

Introduced on main by squash commit 32230bc7acff055a089eaf682d6717ca945b6c7d ('rc (#462)', Felipe Rosa author, committer GitHub, 2025-11-17): git diff 322^..322 adds import execSync + readTranscriptFromCommit + both call sites; immediate parent 6cf64528a04da39cb798dbad6990af8e632ca3c6 has 0 occurrences of readTranscriptFromCommit (verified).

Squash-decomposed to atomic branch writer f5e4e03e1c614b1bcc1764bf93fa7dce6e4c4624 ('Complete taxonomy refactor wish 424', 2025-11-15) whose diff adds the same function and whose parent 3526d97bd356ebb1690455113a46336d05397598 lacks it; f5e4e03e1 carries an explicit AI marker: Co-authored-by: Automagik Genie 🧞 <genie@namastex.ai>. The squash 32230bc7a also carries 31 Co-authored-by trailers incl. Automagik Genie, Claude, Claude Code.

Fix: v3 promotion merge 21de369a5819931d2ad4e88fb71c3baa7524066f (2026-03-07, authored by Automagik Genie) replaced the v2 codebase; its first parent 32bab6ae1a82981d40fe01905398117de18d8a39 (v2.5.28-rc.4) still contained readTranscriptFromCommit (3 occurrences) and the merge result removed it entirely (0 occurrences). First v3.260302.2 tag contains the fix. On the dev lineage the deletion happened in 066b31ef8d343d5897ae1c0acdc04672289b1dff ('feat: restore Genie identity' #510, Automagik Genie) whose parent 523daeec82edda8c738c4fb96d851848f0d44f3a still had the path.

No dedicated security patch before v3; the vulnerable v2 MCP module (incl. the fn and both call sites) was deleted by the v3 rewrite. The gist proof-of-concept (spdc-elm) reproduces RCE against npm automagik-genie@2.5.27.
round6_research.flaw_origin: readTranscriptFromCommit() in src/mcp/server.ts builds `git --git-dir="${gitDir}" log -1 --format="%B" ${commitSha}` via child_process.execSync: commitSha (from Forge API after_head_commit) interpolated OUTSIDE quotes (unrestricted injection); gitDir (from container_ref) inside quotes still evaluates $()/backticks. Second-order: attacker controlling FORGE_BASE_URL or poisoning Forge API responses reaches RCE when a user views a task.
round6_research.reasoning: The command-injection sink readTranscriptFromCommit was first written on main by squash 32230bc7a (rc #462), and decomposes to atomic commit f5e4e03e1 which carries an explicit Co-authored-by: Automagik Genie (the repo's own AI coding agent) trailer on the exact vulnerable lines (blame attributes the function to f5e4e03e1). The whole codebase is largely produced by the Automagik Genie agent with co-author trailers, and this specific introducer is AI-co-authored. AI marker is on the introducer itself (not just on a later fix), so the AI-written code caused the flaw. Fix was a sweeping v3 rewrite (AI-authored) that deleted the vulnerable module rather than patching the sink. Closed causal chain: introducer (AI co-authored) -> vulnerable releases v2.5.10..v2.5.28-rc.4 -> v3 removal.
round6_research.remaining_gap: None. (Fix is a module deletion/rewrite rather than a targeted patch; the removal commits are identified.)

row.scope_statement: The command-injection surface is verified in the v2 MCP implementation; no patched v2 release exists, and v3 closes the issue by removing that surface.

unpatched.reason: No patched v2 release exists; successor v3.260302.2 removes the vulnerable v2 MCP surface.

potential_fix.approach: Backport a targeted v2 change in readTranscriptFromCommit that rejects any after_head_commit value not matching a full hexadecimal commit ID and invokes git with execFileSync (or equivalent no-shell argument-vector execution), passing --git-dir, log options, and the validated commit ID as separate arguments.
potential_fix.rationale: At v2.5.27, both the Forge-supplied commit ID and container-derived git directory are interpolated into an execSync shell string, enabling shell metacharacter and command-substitution interpretation. Full-ID validation plus no-shell argument-vector execution removes that interpreter boundary and prevents option injection. The v3.260302.2 successor only deletes the v2 MCP module and is not evidence of a v2 patch.
